subject: Calibration now comes from inside the playbook
body: Supersedes the 20 s block plan. Two windows per state, opened and closed by the conversation: 'peak:<stateId>' from playbook 1.2 to fullyInAt, and 'contrast:<stateId>' during 3.1 to 3.2. Each window is at least 20 s (I pad with a silent recall). Can you expose start/stop windows, e.g. const w = sensing.window(label); await w.stop() -> CalibrationSummary with quality, usable before start()? Pinned peak and contrast windows from the simulator for the demo. You get the person's own off-state, not just neutral.
